# Epic Global Inc.

> Epic Global Inc. is a wholesale trade partner and marketplace operator based in Utah. It buys brands' inventory upfront at wholesale and sells it on Amazon, Walmart, eBay, TikTok Shop and other marketplaces, paying for the advertising, marketplace fees and fulfillment itself. It is not an agency: no retainers, hourly rates or consulting packages.

## Key facts
- Model: Buy, Sell, Advertise, Protect. Epic buys inventory upfront at wholesale, sells it at retail, funds the advertising, and protects price and catalog (MAP enforcement, removing unauthorized sellers).
- Marketplaces: Amazon, Walmart, eBay, TikTok Shop and select international marketplaces across North America, Europe and other growth regions.
- Founder: Glen Jensen
- Headquarters: Utah, United States
- Get started: [Free marketplace assessment](https://www.epicglobalinc.com/campaigns/marketplace-assessment)

## What Epic does not do
- No retainers, hourly rates or project fees
- No a la carte services or consulting packages
- No revenue share without inventory ownership
